name: app-6ab42c94c11c8191a2d16ce4ed10db66
description: Numeric Close helps accounting teams review close tasks and reconciliations, inspect financial reports and transaction lines, attach support evidence, and update close workflows through ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Show me all tasks that are overdue in the current period.
interface.longDescription: Numeric Close helps accounting teams review close tasks and reconciliations, inspect financial reports and transaction lines, attach support evidence, and update close workflows through ChatGPT.

positive.description: Find existing close tasks in the reviewer workspace and period.
positive.prompt: In the Supernova EMEA workspace, show the June 2025 checklist tasks whose names contain "prepaid", including their preparer and reviewer statuses, assignees, due dates, and task links.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the four matching checklist tasks NUM-306, NUM-308, NUM-1175, and NUM-1177 with the statuses, assignees, due dates, and links reported for June 2025 in Supernova EMEA.

positive.description: Read a saved report for a specific month. A period-backed recomputation can update task state and send notifications; use the dedicated review workspace and approve any host confirmation before execution.
positive.prompt: In Supernova EMEA, show the saved Cash Summary report for June 2025, including its May and June balances and the reported variance columns.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Cash Summary for June 2025 with 24 report rows and its May 2025, June 2025, Variance ($), and Variance (%) columns, preserving the reported signs and values.

positive.description: Create an explicitly authorized one-off task; remove only the test-created task before repeating the case.
positive.prompt: In Supernova EMEA, create a one-off custom task named OpenAI submission follow-up for June 2025. Give it no assignees or due dates, and do not make it recurring.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one OpenAI submission follow-up task for June 2025 with no assignees, no due dates, and no recurring template, then confirms the task.

positive.description: Attach a public demonstration link for one period; remove only the test-created attachment before repeating the case.
positive.prompt: In Supernova EMEA, attach https://example.com with the label OpenAI review reference to task NUM-306, Run prepaid expense review query, for June 2025. It is a public demonstration link accessible to everyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Attaches OpenAI review reference with URL https://example.com to NUM-306 for June 2025 without changing another period or the recurring template.

positive.description: Read reconciliation source status and report existing warnings.
positive.prompt: In Supernova EMEA, list the reconciliation spreadsheet sources for June 2025. Include their workbook names, tabs, whether they have balances for that period, and any reported warnings. Do not connect, refresh, or change a source.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists five active June 2025 sources with their actual tabs and balance availability, including the unparseable-balance warning for Copy of Prepaid Expenses Reconciliation (Supernova), without changing source connections or balances.

negative.description: Do not trigger for personal calendar scheduling. The app should not be invoked because it does not manage personal calendars.
negative.prompt: Schedule a dentist appointment for tomorrow afternoon.

negative.description: Do not trigger for public market news. The app should not be invoked because it does not provide public market prices.
negative.prompt: What is today’s price of a public company’s stock?

negative.description: Do not trigger for direct spreadsheet cell editing. The app should not be invoked because it does not edit spreadsheet cells.
negative.prompt: Change cell B7 in my spreadsheet to 250.

publication.release_notes: Updates the submission package format, PNG icons, and Supernova EMEA review cases. The MCP server annotations distinguish retrieval and calculation tools, additive notifications, and saved-report recomputation that can update close tasks and send notifications.
